title.en: Fable 23 — The Fox and the Crow

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: A crow found a piece of cheese in a yard.

sentences.ar: הוא לקח אותה ועף לעץ גבוה.
sentences.en: He took it and flew to a tall tree.

sentences.ar: הוא ישב על ענף עם הגבינה בפה.
sentences.en: He sat on a branch with the cheese in his mouth.
He wanted to eat it quietly.
A fox passed under the tree and stopped.
He raised his head and looked.
He smelled the cheese at once.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: הנוצות שלך שחורות ויפות.
sentences.en: He said: your feathers are black and beautiful.
He said: your eyes are clever.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: את בטח מלכת הציפורים.
sentences.en: He said: you are surely the queen of the birds.
The crow listened and did not move from the place.

sentences.ar: השועל אמר: יש לי רק שאלה אחת.
sentences.en: The fox said: I have only one question.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: האם גם הקול שלך יפה?
sentences.en: He said: is your voice beautiful too?
The crow wanted to show him at once.

sentences.ar: הוא פתח את הפה וצעק בקול.
sentences.en: He opened his mouth and cried aloud.
The cheese fell straight to the fox.
The fox said: thank you for the song.
